name: scrollspy
title: Scrollspy
description: Marks the section being read in a table of contents, and jumps to a section when you pick its entry: a side rail whose one marker (the row's raised plate and green rail) glides entry to entry on the settle spring, or a strip on the switcher's track and thumb. Any scroller, an offset that clears a sticky header (the scroller's scroll-padding-top by default), smooth jumps that land focus too, and an opt-in URL hash that follows.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/scrollspy.md. SwiftUI: MetalScrollspy in the MetalUI Swift package.
